name: improve
works_with: Any agent that supports the Agent Skills format
short: An AI skill that audits your codebase with your strongest model and writes plans that cheaper models can carry out.
what: improve is an agent skill from shadcn. It maps your repo, audits it across nine categories with parallel subagents, checks every finding itself and shows you a ranked table. You pick which findings become plans, and it writes one self-contained Markdown plan per finding into `plans/`, with exact steps and verification commands. It never changes your source code itself.
who: Developers who want a careful review of a codebase and are happy to hand the work to another agent or do it themselves. Skip it if you want a tool that just fixes things: it only advises and writes plans.
needs: A coding agent that supports Agent Skills

steps.title: Run an audit
steps.text: Open your agent in the repo and run `/improve`, or `/improve quick` to keep it cheap.

steps.title: Choose what to plan
steps.text: It comes back with a findings table. Reply with the ones you want, for example "plan 1, 3 and 5". Plans land in `plans/` with an index and a suggested order.

steps.title: Carry out a plan
steps.text: Hand a plan to any agent, or let the skill dispatch a cheaper model in an isolated worktree and review its diff. Merging stays with you.

steps.title: Keep the backlog current
steps.text: Next session, `/improve reconcile` checks what landed and refreshes plans that drifted. Before a PR, `/improve branch` audits only what your branch changes.

watch: `/improve execute` runs another model in a git worktree, which uses more model calls.
`--issues` publishes plans as GitHub issues, so only use it where that is fine.
It reports where secrets are and what kind, but says it never reproduces their values.
